description: This file defines the `execution_events` package, which manages execution events within the system. It includes data structures for event types and events, an event bus for broadcasting events to subscribers, and helper functions for publishing different types of execution events such as creation, start, update, completion, and failure.

classes.name: ExecutionEventType
classes.description: Type alias for defining the type of execution events, such as created, started, updated, completed, and failed.

classes.name: ExecutionEvent
classes.description: Represents an execution state change event, containing details like type, IDs, status, timestamp, and optional data payload.

classes.name: ExecutionEventBus
classes.description: Manages subscription, unsubscription, and broadcasting of execution events to subscribed channels.

methods.name: NewExecutionEventBus
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of ExecutionEventBus.

methods.name: Subscribe
methods.description: Adds a new subscriber to the event bus and returns a channel for receiving events.

methods.name: Unsubscribe
methods.description: Removes a subscriber from the event bus and closes its channel.

methods.name: Publish
methods.description: Broadcasts an execution event to all current subscribers.

methods.name: GetSubscriberCount
methods.description: Returns the number of active subscribers.

methods.name: ToJSON
methods.description: Converts an execution event to its JSON string representation.

methods.name: PublishExecutionCreated
methods.description: Helper function to publish an 'execution_created' event.

methods.name: PublishExecutionStarted
methods.description: Helper function to publish an 'execution_started' event.

methods.name: PublishExecutionUpdated
methods.description: Helper function to publish an 'execution_updated' event.

methods.name: PublishExecutionCompleted
methods.description: Helper function to publish an 'execution_completed' event.

methods.name: PublishExecutionFailed
methods.description: Helper function to publish an 'execution_failed' event.
